TS-0.1.title: No unverifiable MUST
TS-0.1.normative: Every MUST MUST have a documented independent verification path.
TS-0.1.verification_method: Review registry and generated matrix; no verification fields may be empty.

TS-3.1.title: Single source release identity
TS-3.1.normative: APP_VERSION and BUILD_ID MUST each have exactly one assignment in source; all manifests MUST derive from them.
TS-3.1.verification_method: AST-scan source assignments, then compare generated manifests and runtime identity.

TS-6.1.title: JSONL writer integrity
TS-6.1.normative: The writer MUST NOT create malformed records during normal operation; interrupted shutdown MUST be distinguishable.
TS-6.1.verification_method: Validate every JSONL line and classify malformed tails using explicit shutdown evidence.

TS-7.1.title: Callback attribution
TS-7.1.normative: Instrumented callbacks MUST expose stable name and duration; summary MUST expose P50/P95/P99/max.
TS-7.1.verification_method: Inspect attribution source and validate runtime callback records and summary.

TS-8.1.title: Memory budget ownership
TS-8.1.normative: Each memory budget MUST declare a real owner_path, measurement method and item count; residual MUST NOT be represented as an owner budget.
TS-8.1.verification_method: Inspect estimator registry and compare runtime records to live owner paths.

TS-9.1.title: Estimator lifetime
TS-9.1.normative: Temporary measurement references MUST remain inside measurement scope and MUST NOT escape into callback, queue or cache.
TS-9.1.verification_method: Inspect lexical scope and lifetime helper; run negative lifetime tests.

TS-9.2.title: No measurement deepcopy
TS-9.2.normative: Estimators MUST NOT deepcopy payloads solely for measurement.
TS-9.2.verification_method: Static scan estimator modules for deepcopy/copy patterns and inspect measurement code.

TS-10.1.title: Thread identity
TS-10.1.normative: Every estimator record MUST expose measurement_thread_id, gui_thread_id and is_gui_thread.
TS-10.1.verification_method: Inspect thread identity implementation and validate emitted runtime fields.

TS-10.2.title: GUI thread safety
TS-10.2.normative: Heavy estimators MUST NOT execute on the GUI thread.
TS-10.2.verification_method: Compare measurement_thread_id against gui_thread_id for every heavy estimator record.

TS-11.1.title: Traversal deadline
TS-11.1.normative: Bounded traversal estimators MUST check their deadline inside the traversal loop where cancellation is possible.
TS-11.1.verification_method: Inspect loop body and run deadline regression test.

TS-12.1.title: Burn-in evidence
TS-12.1.normative: A validation burn-in MUST record runtime, RSS, allocator, GC, callback and memory-budget evidence.
TS-12.1.verification_method: Validate required artifact presence and non-empty runtime records.

TS-15.1.title: Telemetry compatibility
TS-15.1.normative: Schema evolution MUST append fields or bump schema_version; existing field meanings MUST NOT change silently.
TS-15.1.verification_method: Diff schema declarations and validate schema_version in runtime records.

TS-16.1.title: Fail-open instrumentation
TS-16.1.normative: Instrumentation MUST fail open and MUST NOT change pipeline semantics.
TS-16.1.verification_method: Inspect exception/lock paths and execute negative failure injection tests.

TS-17.1.title: Shutdown safety
TS-17.1.normative: Instrumentation MUST NOT block shutdown or retain worker/thread/queue references after shutdown.
TS-17.1.verification_method: Inspect shutdown paths and validate clean shutdown lifecycle telemetry.
